title: Agent Test Harness
description:
Implement test harness suites from docs/plans/05-agent-test-harness.md.

Sections: All sections (§1-§10)

Key deliverables:
- Property tests P1-P5: state transition validity, follow-up FIFO, snapshot trigger cardinality, session ID authority, abort idempotency
- Fault injection F1-F5: provider panic recovery, tool hang/timeout, subscriber panic isolation, malformed adapter events, concurrent control storms
- Comparison/oracle O1-O2: native vs adapter event parity, replay oracle
- Deterministic simulations S1-S3: turn engine, control boundary steering, terminal tool
- Benchmarks B1-B4: event fan-out >=100k/s, prompt-to-delta <2ms p95, control queue <5ms p95, memory bounded
- Stress/soak ST1-ST3: 24h multi-agent soak, race-heavy stress, burst follow-up
- Security SEC1-SEC3: event payload sanitization, tool-result boundary, driver-native ID trust
- CI tier matrix with Makefile targets

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/05-agent.md
- Test harness: docs/plans/05-agent-test-harness.md §1-§10
- Depends on: T1 (Agent Core) + T2 (Agent Loop)
